tasks.label: [Pi] Restart All Services and Clear Cache
tasks.command: sudo systemctl stop metixel-backend metixel-cage; rm -f /run/metixel/playlist.json; rm -rf /opt/metixel/data/cache/* 2>/dev/null; sudo systemctl reset-failed metixel-backend metixel-cage; sudo systemctl start metixel-backend metixel-cage; echo restarted

tasks.label: [Pi] Lint
tasks.command: cd /opt/metixel/live && ruff check src/metixel/ testing/ && ruff format --check src/metixel/ testing/

tasks.label: [Local] Build Dashboard CSS
tasks.detail: Compiles input.css + custom.css into dashboard.css (minified) via Tailwind. Run after any custom.css / input.css edit, then bump the ?v= cache-buster in index.html and sync to the Pi.

tasks.label: [Local] Watch Dashboard CSS
tasks.detail: Watches input.css / custom.css and recompiles dashboard.css on every save. Leave running in the background terminal (stop with Ctrl+C).

tasks.label: [Local] Release
tasks.detail: Cuts a release from the dev branch (e.g. minor-beta, beta, rc, stable, minor, major).

tasks.label: [Local] Release Finalize (tag main)
tasks.detail: Tags main with the given version after the release PR has been merged in GitHub.

tasks.label: [Pi] Sync Code (scp)
tasks.detail: Rsyncs src/metixel/ to the selected Pi (excludes caches), then installs it into /opt/metixel/live/src/metixel via sudo rsync. Requires passwordless sudo on the Pi.

tasks.label: [Pi] Sync + Restart All (scp)
tasks.detail: Syncs code, then restarts both backend and frontend on the selected Pi.
tasks.command: sudo systemctl restart metixel-backend metixel-cage && echo '=== Services restarted ==='

tasks.label: [Pi] Sync + Restart Backend (scp)
tasks.detail: Syncs code, then restarts only the backend on the selected Pi.
tasks.command: sudo systemctl restart metixel-backend && echo '=== Backend restarted ==='

tasks.label: [Local] Install Playwright (Web UI Test)
tasks.detail: Installs the Playwright runner + Chromium for the dashboard E2E suite (run once).
tasks.command: npm install && npx playwright install chromium

tasks.label: [Local] Run Web UI Tests (Web UI Test)
tasks.detail: Runs the dashboard Playwright suite from this workstation against the selected Pi.

tasks.label: [Local] Run Functional Tests (All)
tasks.detail: Copies the latest local functional tests to a tmp dir on the selected Pi and runs them there: Wi-Fi + sudo (test mode), then AP in a separate invocation.

tasks.label: [Local] Run Backend
tasks.detail: Runs the metixel backend daemon on this PC (scans media, builds the playlist, serves the web UI on :8080).

tasks.label: [Local] Run Frontend (Tk)
tasks.detail: Runs the frontend renderer on this PC using the tkinter desktop backend (opens a Tk slideshow window). Start the backend first.

tasks.label: [Local] Stop Services
tasks.detail: Stops the locally running metixel backend/frontend python processes on this PC.
tasks.command: pkill -f 'metixel.*--mode' || true; echo 'Local metixel processes stopped'

tasks.label: [Local] Run Tests
tasks.detail: Runs the pytest suite on this PC using the .venv interpreter (no coverage).

tasks.label: [Local] Lint
tasks.detail: Runs ruff check + ruff format --check on src/metixel/ AND testing/ (CI scope) using the .venv interpreter.
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check src/metixel/ testing/ && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check src/metixel/ testing/

tasks.label: [Local] Type Check
tasks.detail: Runs mypy on src/metixel/ and testing/ on this PC using the .venv interpreter.

tasks.label: [Local] Simulate Blocked Update (Pi 3)
tasks.detail: Runs the local backend with a fake Pi 3 and a fake 2.0.0 release, so the Updates card shows the 'automatic update paused' notice. No network calls; nothing is installed. Open http://127.0.0.1:8080/ -> Advanced -> Updates.

tasks.label: [Local] Simulate Allowed Update (Pi 5)
tasks.detail: Same simulation but with a capable board, so the notice stays hidden and the Install button is offered — useful for checking the notice is not shown when it should not be.

tasks.label: [Local] Verify Functional Sudo Guard
tasks.command: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 pi@192.168.222.122 'cd /tmp/functest && python3 -m pytest test_sudo.py -q --no-cov 2>&1 | tail -32'

tasks.label: [Local] Verify Functional Suite Banner
tasks.command: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 pi@192.168.222.122 'cd /tmp/functest && python3 -m pytest . -q --no-cov 2>&1 | tail -30'

tasks.label: [Local] Verify Functional Banner Head
tasks.command: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 pi@192.168.222.122 'cd /tmp/functest && python3 -m pytest . -q --no-cov 2>&1 | head -25'

tasks.label: [Local] Verify Env Path Resolution
tasks.command: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 pi@192.168.222.122 'cd /tmp/functest && cp /opt/metixel/live/testing/functional/.env.example .env 2>/dev/null && echo "copied .env.example -> .env" && sed -i "s/^METIXEL_TEST_WIFI_SSID=.*/METIXEL_TEST_WIFI_SSID=TESTNET/" .env && python3 -m pytest test_wifi.py -q --no-cov 2>&1 | head -14; rm -f /tmp/functest/.env'

tasks.label: [Local] Quality Gate After Functional Fix

tasks.label: [Local] Normalise Functional Test Line Endings
tasks.command: file testing/functional/conftest.py testing/functional/test_sudo.py && echo "--- normalising to LF ---" && sed -i 's/\r$//' testing/functional/conftest.py testing/functional/test_sudo.py && file testing/functional/conftest.py testing/functional/test_sudo.py && git diff --stat -- testing/functional/

tasks.label: [Local] Final Verify Functional Changes
tasks.command: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check testing/functional/ && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check testing/functional/ && echo "--- local suite unchanged (should be 50 skipped, no banner) ---" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest testing/functional/ -q --no-cov 2>&1 | tail -3

tasks.label: [Local] Test Sudoers Reconcile Block
tasks.command: bash -n scripts/reconcile.sh && echo "syntax OK" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest testing/unit_tests/backend/test_reconcile_sudoers.py -q --no-cov 2>&1 | tail -25

tasks.label: [Local] Check Pi Sudoers State
tasks.command: scp -q scripts/reconcile.sh pi@192.168.222.122:/tmp/reconcile-new.sh && ssh pi@192.168.222.122 'echo "=== current state: is there a sudoers rule? ==="; ls -la /etc/sudoers.d/ | grep -i pi || echo "NO pi rule (as expected)"; echo; echo "=== NOTE: dry-run needs root, and sudo -n is blocked ==="; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -2'

tasks.label: [Local] Verify Sudoers Write Logic
tasks.command:
set -e
echo "=== 1. Extract the sudoers block and prove it writes a valid file ==="
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
# Simulate the write logic against a fake root.
SUDOERS_DIR="$TMP/etc/sudoers.d"
mkdir -p "$SUDOERS_DIR"
SUDOERS_FILE="$SUDOERS_DIR/010_pi-nopasswd"
_tmp_sudoers="$(mktemp)"
printf 'pi ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL\n' > "${_tmp_sudoers}"
if visudo -c -f "${_tmp_sudoers}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "  visudo -c -f: VALID"; else echo "  visudo -c -f: INVALID (unexpected)"; exit 1; fi
install -m 0440 "${_tmp_sudoers}" "${SUDOERS_FILE}"
rm -f "${_tmp_sudoers}"
echo "  installed:"; stat -c '    %A %U:%G %n' "${SUDOERS_FILE}"
echo "  content: $(cat "${SUDOERS_FILE}")"
echo
echo "=== 2. Prove a MALFORMED rule is rejected before install ==="
BAD=$(mktemp)
printf 'pi ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD ALL\n' > "$BAD"
if visudo -c -f "$BAD" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "  BAD rule passed validation — test is wrong"; else echo "  malformed rule REJECTED (good — guards against lockout)"; fi
visudo -c -f "$BAD" 2>&1 | head -2 || true
rm -f "$BAD"; rm -rf "$TMP"

tasks.label: [Local] Full Quality Gate
tasks.command: .venv/bin/python -m ruff format testing/unit_tests/backend/test_reconcile_sudoers.py >/dev/null && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check src/metixel/ testing/ && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check src/metixel/ testing/ && .venv/bin/python -m mypy src/metixel/ testing/ 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "--- unit tests ---" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest testing/unit_tests/ -q --no-cov 2>&1 | tail -4

tasks.label: [Local] Review Sudoers Change Set
tasks.command: rm -f /tmp/reconcile-new.sh; sed -i 's/\r$//' scripts/reconcile.sh testing/unit_tests/backend/test_reconcile_sudoers.py; file scripts/reconcile.sh | grep -q CRLF && echo "WARN: CRLF" || echo "line endings OK (LF)"; echo; git --no-pager diff --stat -- scripts/reconcile.sh; git status --porcelain
